title: [P3] Dev DX: native sqlite driver ABI mismatch on newer Node; PORT→OS_PORT; auth Origin requirement
body:
## Problem (dev DX)
1. The dev server defaults to the native `better-sqlite3` driver; its prebuilt binary's ABI doesn't match newer Node (e.g. Node 25 → `NODE_MODULE_VERSION` mismatch), so `objectstack dev` fails to persist until you manually rebuild from source. Consider defaulting dev to the wasm driver, or shipping prebuilds for current Node.
2. Minor: `PORT` env var is deprecated in favor of `OS_PORT` (warns on every boot). `better-auth` email sign-in returns 403 without an `Origin` header (trips simple API clients).

## Affected
driver packaging / CLI dev defaults / auth + env DX.


---
_Found while runtime-testing `objectstack-ai/templates` (all 9 templates via `objectstack dev all`) on `@objectstack` 9.5.1. Build + typecheck pass; these only surface at runtime._
